technicalBulletins.title: Triumph Technical Bulletin 180.9 (October 2017) — front wheel brake damper revision
technicalBulletins.summary: A front-wheel assembly revision introduced brake dampers at different production breakpoints: India/Brazil from 831860; other markets from 829122. The bulletins specify stock Triumph wheel arrangements; aftermarket Kineo wheels require supplier/dealer evidence. No individual fitment claim is made.
